description: A boy with short brown hair in a dark sailor-collared top and shorts stands in dense green foliage, holding a black box camera with a top viewfinder hood up to his face and looking down into it. A shaggy, dark-and-tan terrier-type dog sits at the lower right, looking up at him. Painterly, dark oil-style brushwork; the painting fills the frame edge to edge. A tiny faint mark sits in the bottom right corner.
